content: नाटकम् [नट्-ण्वुल्] .²1 A play, drama (in general). .²2 The first of the 10 principal kinds of dramatic composition; for definition and other information see <ls>S. D. 277</ls>, where 36 लक्षणs of a नाटक are given. .{@-कः@} An actor, a dancer; वधूनाटकसंघैश्च संयुक्तां सर्वतः पुरीम् <ls>Rām. 1. 5. 12</ls>. .{@-की@} The court of Indra.
